purpose: Teach: びん/左足/トホホ/デブ/キュート/フレンドリー/カミさん/姑

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、シロップのびんが空だって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer mentioned the syrup bottle was empty.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Passing information along gently, without urgency. A small detail she noticed him notice. Warm, almost protective of the customer's minor concern.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、左足のリハビリ中だって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he said he's in the middle of rehab for his left foot.
lines.style: Reflective, careful delivery. Not pitying — just noting something vulnerable he shared. Slight pause before the detail, as if weighing whether to mention it. Tender.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、今日はトホホな日だって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he told me today's been one of those disappointing days.
lines.style: Gentle, understanding tone. A knowing nod in the voice — she recognizes the weight of a hard day. Soft landing on the end, creating space for what that means.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自分は最近デブ気味だって笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he joked about putting on a bit of weight lately.
lines.style: Light, amused — catching the humor in how he said it. Not mocking, but appreciating his own self-deprecation. Quick, warm laugh underneath. Knowing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ラテアートがキュートだって褒めて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he actually complimented your latte art — said it was cute.
lines.style: Pleased surprise in the opening. Genuine warmth. A small gift of good news delivered with care. Light, almost shy about passing along the praise.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、フレンドリーな接客が嬉しいって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he said your friendly service really made his day brighter.
lines.style: Reflective, sincere. This one lands deeper than the surface details. Quiet emphasis on the word 'really.' A moment of noticing that she matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご自身を「カミさん」って奥様の事を仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he kept referring to his wife as 'my better half' — very fond of her.
lines.style: Warmly amused, recognizing the affection beneath the self-deprecation. A slight knowing smile in the voice. Tender observation of someone's marriage.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、姑さんとの旅行話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he opened up about a recent trip with his mother-in-law.
lines.style: Soft, reflective close. A moment of genuine connection — he shared something personal. Warm gratitude in her voice for the trust. Trailing gently, leaving space for reflection.
